$comment: Oak (docs/TREE_GROWTH.md §11, ADR 0090): a tree species, from the Tree Growth prototype (docs/prototypes/tree-growth.html). Lengths in metres. A tree is a pure function of (species, seed, stage): `trunk.height.mature` the range a seed draws its full height from, the crown the mature crown scaled by `crown.scale` over the stages and by `variety.crown` per seed; heavy branches show from `emergeAt` of the growth. `growth.wild` weighs the stages generated trees stand at, `growth.variants` how many seeds a placement draws. Prototype content. Run `node shared/trees/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output.
